coordinateContract.requiredInput: aligned DICOM series with explicit ImagePositionPatient, ImageOrientationPatient, and PixelSpacing

sourceSpaceAcquisition.provisionalLandmarkStatus: source-space visual localization only; not anatomically reviewed and not Patient Space
sourceSpaceAcquisition.sourceHashStatus: per-source-file SHA-256 recorded in artifact manifest
sourceSpaceAcquisition.coordinateWarning: Original female cryosections contain transverse offsets. Filename-derived source position and this rectangular crop are not a substitute for explicit Patient Space alignment.

selectionProtocol.landmarkMethod: manually identify the radiocarpal joint center on the aligned anatomical source before patient-space promotion; record the source instance and patient-space point
selectionProtocol.sliceNormalRequirement: all selected aligned source instances must pass ph_dicom.validate_and_sort_series

longitudinalBounds.proximal: include source slices through at least 120 mm proximal to the radiocarpal-joint-center along the validated series slice-normal direction
longitudinalBounds.distal: include source slices through at least 30 mm distal to the radiocarpal-joint-center along the validated series slice-normal direction
longitudinalBounds.reason: bounded engineering ROI for distal forearm/wrist authoring; these distances define crop scope and are not anatomical-accuracy claims

inPlaneBounds.method: smallest single rectangular pixel crop containing the complete left-limb skin envelope on every selected aligned slice, expanded by 15 mm on each in-plane side
inPlaneBounds.reason: retain local context while keeping the runtime/authoring region bounded; the margin is an engineering crop margin, not a medical measurement

selectionProtocol.outputMethod: record selected SOP Instance UIDs and PixelCrop, then compute the exact patient-space AABB with ph_dicom.patient_extent_for_crop

blockingChecks: candidate cryosection series has an explicit documented alignment state
left laterality is verified from aligned source orientation rather than filename inference
required aligned source instances contain usable DICOM patient geometry
FrameOfReferenceUID is internally consistent when supplied
required vessel visibility is reviewed before vessel draft-mask creation/promotion
completedChecks: bounded source archive bytes for A05 were acquired
SHA-256 provenance is recorded per acquired source file in the A05 artifact manifest
source-space forearm/wrist crop was materialized without committing medical image bytes to Git
knownSourceConstraint: The original Visible Human Female cryosection sequence contains transverse-plane offsets, and the source CT is not automatically a precise registration target for the cryosections. Raw filename-derived coordinates therefore do not satisfy this ROI's patient-space contract.
completionCondition: Populate coordinateContract only from an explicitly aligned source series with measured Patient Space geometry. The acquired source-space stack is sufficient for A05 draft authoring work, but not for a patient-space or CT-registration claim.
